deployment: Local comparison data only; not deployed to the review service.
policy: Scan-only boundary refinement uses cubic profile interpolation and finer coordinate-descent steps. Frozen mono-color templates, cohorts, fitting/selection/certification strips and acceptance thresholds are unchanged. New plain-land template has eight predetermined calibration names; all art variants of a name remain together. Validate translation, uniform/anisotropic scale, rotation and skew under original and altered color/saturation. Three disjoint frame-strip groups, content isolation and actual raster replay remain required. Renderer geometry does not inherit per-card transforms. Historic pigment scores retain their historic validated poses; these new poses require fresh color scores before reusing them for color adoption.

land.calibrationPolicy: First eight distinct names by SHA256(M21-land-normalization-v1:name), fixed before observing fit scores. All art variants of a name stay together.
